items.title: 13.5 Halogens ke hydrogen ke saath reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.5, printed pages 295-296.

blocks.text: Jab halogens hydrogen se react karte hain to hydrogen halides bante hain.

blocks.text_alt: H₂ + X₂ → 2HX   jahan X₂ = F₂, Cl₂, Br₂ ya I₂

blocks.text: Hydrogen halides be-rang (colourless) gases hain jo pani mein hal ho kar hydrohalic acid banati hain. Group mein fluorine se iodine tak neeche jate hue halogens ki hydrogen ke saath reactivity kam hoti jati hai.
Kam temperature par aur andhere mein bhi fluorine hydrogen se dhamake (explosion) ke saath react karti hai.
Yeh gas (HF) pani mein hal ho to hydrofluoric acid banti hai.

UV roshni ya chingari (spark) mein chlorine hydrogen se aasani se react kar ke be-rang HCl gas banati hai, jo pani mein hydrochloric acid banati hai. Arrow par likha hν roshni (light) ki energy ka nishan hai.

Bromine ko hydrogen ke saath garam kiya jaye to hydrogen bromide (HBr) gas banti hai. HBr gas HCl aur HF se kam reactive hai. Pani mein yeh strong hydrobromic acid banati hai. Yeh exothermic (heat nikalne wala) reaction hai. Arrow par Δ ka matlab hai garam karna.

Zyada temperature par aur catalyst (reaction tez karne wala madda jo khud kharch nahi hota) ki maujoodgi mein iodine hydrogen se react kar ke hydrogen iodide (HI) gas banati hai, jo pani mein hydroiodic acid banati hai.
Yeh reversible (dono taraf chalne wala) reaction hai aur bohat aahista hota hai.

blocks.prompt: H₂ aur F₂ ka reaction dhamake wala kyun hai, jab ke H₂ aur I₂ ka reaction aahista aur reversible hai?
blocks.explanation: F–F bond kamzor (156 kJ mol⁻¹) hai aur banne wala H–F bond bohat mazboot (569 kJ mol⁻¹) hai, is liye bohat energy nikalti hai aur reaction foran ho jata hai. I₂ ke liye H–I bond (299 kJ mol⁻¹) kamzor hai, is liye thori energy nikalti hai; reaction ko garmi aur catalyst chahiye aur kamzor HI aasani se wapas H₂ aur I₂ mein toot jata hai, is liye reaction reversible hai.

items: H₂ + X₂ → 2HX; HX be-rang gases hain jo pani mein hydrohalic acids banati hain.
Reactivity F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂: F₂ andhere mein dhamaka, Cl₂ UV ya spark, Br₂ garam karne par, I₂ garmi aur catalyst se aahista aur reversible.
